newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 sets new record high as squeeze continues.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 sets new record high as squeeze continues.

text.p: The FTSE 100 powered to a fresh record high, shooting up up 39.8 points, or nearly one percent, to 4,721 by 0910 GMT.
Dealers said position-squaring ahead of the weekend and in view of Tuesday's FOMC meeting found the market short of stock.
The 0930 GMT expiry of index options also helped push the index ahead, they said.

"We're still squeezing up, there are bulls and bears and the picture is mixed but overall we are seeing people closing positions at the week end and some boys are getting caught short," said one senior dealer.
By 0916 GMT the FTSE 100 was 42.5 points up at 4,723.7.
The index set its previous record intra-day high of 4,720.3 on Tuesday.
